propositions: Runtime marker files (*/.archived, */.write.lock) are tracked in the tickets branch HEAD despite .gitignore patterns, causing git status pollution and blocking plan-review attestations that require strict head checks.

The untrack-runtime-markers ensure unit removes tracked marker files from git index via batched git rm --cached without touching worktree copies, with one commit per run and idempotent re-runs making zero commits.

Reader self-healing in reducer/_api.py re-materializes missing .archived markers for archived tickets during the exclude_archived list path, restoring fast-path cache after peer merges delete tracked worktree files.
Peers merging the untrack commit have their worktree marker files cleanly deleted by git while maintaining clean status, with subsequent list calls re-creating markers as needed.
